doc.caveat: This document names a TAXON and carries a DECLARED parameter set: quantities the designer stated, each with a source saying where it came from. Nobody measured them on this organism, and the engine holds measured parameters only for the organisms in its bundle. Every declared value enters STATE with kind "assumed", so the weakest-input machinery and every model_confidence downstream carry the fact that a person stated it. A result computed from them is a statement about those declarations as much as about the organism; fields nobody declared stay null and the checks that need them still refuse.

result.clade_note: The taxon is placed, so every law that scopes to one of these clades will be judged for this organism, and a law scoped elsewhere is reported out of scope with its clade named.

what_runs_now.lean_check: runs: the taxon decides clade scope. Laws needing a body-plan quantity return cannot-evaluate, naming the missing input.
what_runs_now.organism_get: refuses: STATE is age-scaled parameters and there is no parameter and no ontogeny track for this taxon.
what_runs_now.physics_check: refuses: it runs scenarios over a resolved STATE.
what_runs_now.closest_relative_phenotype: refuses unless a reference set covers this clade.
what_runs_now.functional_resolution: runs, and fails its gate unless the requested function is in the registry.

result.scope: A document, not an organism and not a measurement. The taxon and the ontology terms are real; there is NO parameter set, so nothing dimensional has been established and no check that needs a length, a mass or an area can return a result for it. This document names a TAXON and carries no reference parameter set, because this engine holds measured parameters only for the organisms in its bundle. Every parameter is therefore null, and every check that needs one returns cannot-evaluate. The taxon IS used: law scope is decided from it, so a law calibrated on another clade is reported out of scope rather than applied. Nothing here is a measurement of this organism, and no number has been substituted for one.
